description: A React component for displaying a searchable, filterable index of databases with statistics, categories, features, and documentation info, including support for compatible databases.
external_methods: antd components (Card, Row, Col, Statistic, Table, Tag, Input, Select, Tooltip)
ant-design icons (DatabaseOutlined, CheckCircleOutlined, ApiOutlined, KeyOutlined, SearchOutlined, LinkOutlined, BugOutlined)

classes.name: DatabaseIndex
classes.description: React functional component rendering a database index table with filtering, sorting, and statistics.

methods.name: getCategoryDisplayName
methods.description: Converts category constant to display name.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Determines categories for a database, using documentation metadata or inferring from name.

methods.name: countTimeGrains
methods.description: Counts supported time grains for a database.

methods.name: formatTimeGrain
methods.description: Formats time grain name for display.

methods.description: Returns list of supported time grains for tooltip display.
